verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.
verses.pt: “Envia homens que reconheçam a terra de Canaã, a qual eu dou aos filhos de Israel; de cada tribo de seus pais enviareis um homem, cada um líder entre eles.”
verses.en_web: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”
verses.en_bbe: Send men to get knowledge about the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the children of Israel; from every tribe of their fathers you are to send a man, every one a chief among them.

verses.en: And Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.
verses.pt: E Moisés os enviou desde o deserto de Parã, conforme a palavra do SENHOR; e todos aqueles homens eram líderes dos filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of Yahweh. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses sent them from the waste land of Paran as the Lord gave orders, all of them men who were heads of the children of Israel.

verses.en: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
verses.pt: Os nomes dos quais são estes: da tribo de Rúben, Samua, filho de Zacur.
verses.en_web: These were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
verses.en_bbe: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua, the son of Zaccur.

verses.en: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
verses.pt: Da tribo de Simeão, Safate, filho de Hori.
verses.en_web: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
verses.en_bbe: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat, the son of Hori.

verses.en: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.pt: Da tribo de Judá, Calebe, filho de Jefoné.
verses.en_web: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.en_bbe: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb, the son of Jephunneh.

verses.en: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
verses.pt: Da tribo de Issacar, Jigeal, filho de José.
verses.en_web: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
verses.en_bbe: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal, the son of Joseph.

verses.en: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.
verses.pt: Da tribo de Efraim, Oseias, filho de Num.
verses.en_web: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.
verses.en_bbe: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea, the son of Nun.

verses.en: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
verses.pt: Da tribo de Benjamim, Palti, filho de Rafu.
verses.en_web: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
verses.en_bbe: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti, the son of Raphu.

verses.en: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
verses.pt: Da tribo de Zebulom, Gadiel, filho de Sodi.
verses.en_web: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
verses.en_bbe: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel, the son of Sodi.

verses.en: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
verses.pt: Da tribo de José: pela tribo de Manassés, Gadi, filho de Susi.
verses.en_web: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
verses.en_bbe: Of the tribe of Joseph, that is of the family of Manasseh, Gaddi, the son of Susi.

verses.en: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
verses.pt: Da tribo de Dã, Amiel, filho de Gemali.
verses.en_web: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
verses.en_bbe: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel, the son of Gemalli.

verses.en: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
verses.pt: Da tribo de Aser, Setur, filho de Micael.
verses.en_web: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
verses.en_bbe: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur, the son of Michael

verses.en: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
verses.pt: Da tribo de Naftali, Nabi, filho de Vofsi.
verses.en_web: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
verses.en_bbe: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi, the son of Vophsi.

verses.en: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
verses.pt: Da tribo de Gade, Guel, filho de Maqui.
verses.en_web: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
verses.en_bbe: Of the tribe of Gad, Gevel, the son of Machi.

verses.en: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.
verses.pt: Estes são os nomes dos homens que Moisés enviou para reconhecer a terra; e a Oseias, filho de Num, Moisés lhe pôs o nome de Josué.
verses.en_web: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.
verses.en_bbe: These are the names of the men whom Moses sent to get knowledge about the land. And Moses gave to Hoshea, the son of Nun, the name of Joshua.

verses.en: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:
verses.pt: Então Moisés os enviou para reconhecer a terra de Canaã, dizendo-lhes: “Subi por aqui, pelo sul, e subi ao monte:
verses.en_web: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country.
verses.en_bbe: So Moses sent them to have a look at the land of Canaan, and said to them, Go up into the South and into the hill-country;

verses.en: And see the land, what it is; and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;
verses.pt: e observai a terra que tal é; e o povo que a habita, se é forte ou débil, se pouco ou numeroso;
verses.en_web: See the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;
verses.en_bbe: And see what the land is like; and if the people living in it are strong or feeble, small or great in number;

verses.en: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;
verses.pt: qual é a terra habitada, se é boa ou má; e quais são as cidades habitadas, se de tendas ou de fortalezas;
verses.en_web: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;
verses.en_bbe: And what sort of land they are living in, if it is good or bad; and what their living-places are, tent-circles or walled towns;

verses.en: And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.
verses.pt: e qual é o terreno, se é fértil ou fraco, se nele há ou não árvores; esforçai-vos, e colhei do fruto daquela terra.” E o tempo era o tempo das primeiras uvas.
verses.en_web: and what the land is, whether it is fat or lean, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.
verses.en_bbe: And if the land is fertile or poor, and if there is wood in it or not. And be of good heart, and come back with some of the produce of the land. Now it was the time when the first grapes were ready.

verses.en: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.
verses.pt: E eles subiram, e reconheceram a terra desde o deserto de Zim até Reobe, entrando em Hamate.
verses.en_web: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.
verses.en_bbe: So they went up and got a view of the land, from the waste land of Zin to Rehob, on the way to Hamath.

verses.en: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
verses.pt: E subiram pelo sul, e vieram até Hebrom: e ali estavam Aimã, e Sesai, e Talmai, filhos de Anaque. Hebrom foi edificada sete anos antes de Zoã, a do Egito.
verses.en_web: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
verses.en_bbe: They went up into the South and came to Hebron; and Ahiman and Sheshai and Talmai, the children of Anak, were living there. (Now the building of Hebron took place seven years before that of Zoan in Egypt.)

verses.en: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.
verses.pt: E chegaram até o ribeiro de Escol, e dali cortaram um ramo com um cacho de uvas, o qual trouxeram dois em uma vara, e das romãs e dos figos.
verses.en_web: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.
verses.en_bbe: And they came to the valley of Eshcol, and cutting down a vine-branch with its grapes, two of them took it on a rod between them; and they took some pomegranates and figs.

verses.en: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.
verses.pt: E chamou-se aquele lugar vale de Escol pelo cacho que cortaram dali os filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.
verses.en_bbe: That place was named the valley of Eshcol because of the grapes which the children of Israel took from there.

verses.en: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.
verses.pt: E voltaram de reconhecer a terra ao fim de quarenta dias.
verses.en_web: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.
verses.en_bbe: At the end of forty days they came back from viewing the land.

verses.en: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.
verses.pt: E andaram e vieram a Moisés e a Arão, e a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, no deserto de Parã, em Cades, e deram-lhes a resposta, e a toda a congregação, e lhes mostraram o fruto da terra.
verses.en_web: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.
verses.en_bbe: And they came back to Moses and Aaron and all the children of Israel, to Kadesh in the waste land of Paran; and gave an account to them and to all the people and let them see the produce of the land.

verses.en: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.
verses.pt: E lhe contaram, e disseram: Nós chegamos à terra à qual nos enviaste, a que certamente flui leite e mel; e este é o fruto dela.
verses.en_web: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
verses.en_bbe: And they said, We came to the land where you sent us, and truly it is flowing with milk and honey: and here is some of the produce of it.

verses.en: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
verses.pt: Mas o povo que habita aquela terra é forte, e as cidades muito grandes e fortes; e também vimos ali os filhos de Anaque.
verses.en_web: However the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.
verses.en_bbe: But the people living in the land are strong, and the towns are walled and very great; further, we saw the children of Anak there.

verses.en: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.
verses.pt: Amaleque habita a terra do sul; e os heteus, e os jebuseus, e os amorreus, habitam no monte; e os cananeus habitam junto ao mar, e à beira do Jordão.
verses.en_web: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Amalekites are in the South; and the Hittites and the Jebusites and the Amorites are living in the hill-country; and the Canaanites by the sea and by the side of Jordan.

verses.en: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
verses.pt: Então Calebe fez calar o povo diante de Moisés, e disse: Subamos logo, e passemos a ela; que mais poderemos que ela.
verses.en_web: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!”
verses.en_bbe: Then Caleb made signs to the people to keep quiet, and said to Moses, Let us go up straight away and take this land; for we are well able to overcome it.

verses.en: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.
verses.pt: Mas os homens que subiram com ele, disseram: Não poderemos subir contra aquele povo; porque é mais forte que nós.
verses.en_web: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”
verses.en_bbe: But the men who had gone up with him said, We are not able to go up against the people, for they are stronger than we.

verses.en: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.
verses.pt: E falaram mal entre os filhos de Israel da terra que haviam reconhecido, dizendo: A terra por de onde passamos para reconhecê-la, é terra que consome a seus moradores; e todo o povo que vimos em meio dela, são homens de grande estatura.
verses.en_web: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.
verses.en_bbe: And they gave the children of Israel a bad account of the land they had been to see, saying, This land through which we went is a land causing destruction to those living in it; and all the people we saw there are men of more than common size.

verses.en: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
verses.pt: Também vimos ali gigantes, filhos de Anaque, raça dos gigantes: e éramos nós, à nossa aparência, como gafanhotos; e assim lhes parecíamos a eles.
verses.en_web: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”
verses.en_bbe: There we saw those great men, the sons of Anak, offspring of the Nephilim: and we seemed to ourselves no more than insects, and so we seemed to them.
